escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, the start line of a technology race inside a dark hangar-like Efeonce studio at night): she (the woman of the references, her face exactly as in the references) wears the bionic suit exactly as in its reference, WITH the small navy Efeonce isotype inlaid on her chest plate on her left side exactly as in the reference and the macro (no other logo, no lettering). Tight cinematic close framing from the chest up on the RIGHT half of the frame, the camera close to her face at eye level, 85mm f/1.4, razor-thin focus on her eyes: she looks straight into the lens with a fearless, confident half-smile. Around her, a squad of FIVE Sparks, copied EXACTLY from their two references, each smaller than her head, all ready to race with her: one sits on her shoulder pumping a tiny fist, sharp; one hovers low over a ledge in the foreground, leaning forward as if ready to launch; behind her, at unequal heights and distances, EXACTLY THREE more Sparks (FIVE in total, never more), the same figures as the Spark references, smaller in frame and out of focus, their LED eyes reading as glowing dots: one leans forward ready to launch, one gives a thumbs-up, one is caught mid-leap with excitement. Their LED eyes and her suit seams are the only blue light sources; a hard key light from the left sculpts her face; volumetric haze and a cool rim light behind; anamorphic flares kept subtle. The LEFT half of the frame is calm, dark, empty studio space with soft haze and no objects. No readable text anywhere.
